verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is Zoho Invoice's own marketing claim that it sends "tax-compliant invoices". That points to native tax handling on invoices, but nothing shows how sales tax, VAT or GST is calculated, or how registrations and rates are configured. missing for 10: documented sales tax/VAT/GST calculation, tax rate configuration, tax registration management, multi-jurisdiction coverage, any first-class tax integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, sales tax, VAT, and GST are calculated on every invoice — natively or through a first-class tax integration — with the right registrations and rates
